purpose: Catalog of supplier, marketplace, and API routes for AutoStop procurement price and availability checks.
principles: Красноярск stock and pickup first; Siberia and Russia-wide order second.
Use official API, contracted price list export, supplier cabinet, phone confirmation, or public marketplace pages only.
Do not scrape closed supplier cabinets unless the supplier explicitly permits it.
Separate закупочная цена, public retail, client sale price, package price, and repair-order line total.
Store evidence fields with every quote so the agent can re-check quickly later.

sources.name: ROSSKO / Росско
sources.api_status: api_keys_available_for_registered_account; confirm official terms with ROSSKO manager
sources.verification: Use as a high-priority Krasnoyarsk source after AutoStop account/API keys are available. Confirm warehouse, pickup address, price type, and return terms before writing закупка.
sources.role: Krasnoyarsk-first procurement, stock, lead time, order/reserve candidate.

sources.name: ARMTEK / Армтек
sources.verification: Treat as B2B supplier route. Use only account-approved API/ETP or exported price lists; confirm Krasnoyarsk logistics.
sources.role: B2B procurement and stock/lead-time benchmark candidate.

sources.name: Autopiter / Автопитер
sources.verification: Use for Russia-wide закупка and supplier comparison; оптовые цены require legal-entity registration/account.
sources.role: Russia-wide procurement, OEM/analog search, and webservice candidate.

sources.name: AutoEuro API / АвтоЕвро
sources.verification: API can confirm price, stock, delivery, create orders, and check order status after API activation in the client account.
sources.role: Supplier API for price/stock confirmation and order status after account activation.

sources.name: ZZap
sources.verification: Use public search as price benchmark and seller comparison; API route requires partner approval and should not replace supplier-confirmed закупка.
sources.role: RF market benchmark, replacements visibility, seller comparison, and average/stat price candidate.

sources.name: PARTSAPI.RU
sources.verification: Use for fitment, TecDoc-style crosses, VIN/frame/OEM routing, not as a procurement price source unless a price endpoint is explicitly confirmed.

sources.name: MANN-FILTER Catalog
sources.verification: Use public_aftermarket_catalog_lookup for filter/OE/catalog enrichment. It is not a VIN-specific OEM EPC and does not provide AutoStop закупка or Красноярск stock.

sources.name: DENSO Aftermarket Catalog
sources.verification: Use public_aftermarket_catalog_lookup for DENSO/OE search and detail checks. VIN search is DENSO fitment only and does not replace OEM EPC or supplier price confirmation.

sources.name: UMAPI
sources.verification: Evaluate for supplier price-list exchange and catalog enrichment; do not assume it provides Красноярск stock without connected suppliers.

sources.name: AutoSputnik / Автоспутник API
sources.api_status: public legacy API docs; new API migration noted by supplier
sources.verification: Use only after supplier login and current API endpoint are confirmed; legacy docs mention migration and shutdown timing.

sources.name: APEC API
sources.verification: Use as import/Russia-order benchmark if commercial account and delivery route are relevant to AutoStop.

sources.name: AUTOPOISK
sources.api_status: RESTful API advertised; commercial subscription/demo required
sources.verification: Use for professional catalog/cross/OEM enrichment and supplier-market context; not a direct закупка source until connected supplier prices are verified.

sources.name: Emex
sources.api_status: official SOAP documentation found at wsdoc.emex.ru; AutostopManager FindDetailAdv5 adapter is ready, but live use needs EMEX_LOGIN, EMEX_PASSWORD, Emex service approval, and server IP whitelist
sources.verification: Use city/account settings and compare exact article, delivery time, delivery probability, quantity, price, and return terms. Do not scrape closed cabinet/API pages.
sources.role: Russia-wide cabinet benchmark and official SOAP price/stock candidate for exact article and delivery.

sources.name: Exist
sources.api_status: AutostopManager has a public read-only Exist adapter using /Api/Parts/Search, /Price/?pcode=..., /Price/?pid=..., and office cookie _go=905; treat output as public_retail_reference, not confirmed закупка
sources.verification: Use VIN/catalog route first, then exact article price and delivery check. Keep Exist as public_retail_reference with confidence and requires-confirmation in internal quote evidence, not in the public card description; do not use login, basket, order, private cabinet, or raw HTML.
sources.role: Public read-only Exist retail benchmark, catalog disambiguation, analog visibility, and lead-time reference for exact article checks.

sources.name: Autodoc
sources.api_status: not_confirmed_for_autostop; treat as cabinet/manual until contract exists
sources.verification: Use as secondary supplier and cross-check; confirm city delivery and returns.
sources.role: Russia/Europe retail benchmark and secondary article availability check.

sources.name: Пятая передача
sources.api_status: site integration page exists; API terms need direct confirmation
sources.verification: Use for Krasnoyarsk fluids and common service materials; confirm price and stock because site functionality depends on live catalog/login.

sources.name: Liqui Moly Красноярск
sources.verification: Use as local fluids benchmark only when OEM approval/spec and package size are clear.

sources.name: Drom Parts Красноярск
sources.verification: Use exact OEM and vehicle/model queries; verify city, photos, seller, warranty, and whether price is for one item or a set.

sources.name: EuroAuto public catalog
sources.verification: EuroAuto is not AutoEuro. Use the public catalog by exact OEM/article first; a VIN only narrows catalog selection. Verify the current listing, condition, donor/fitment notes, delivery to Krasnoyarsk, warranty, and return terms. Do not automate login, basket, checkout, messages, private/mobile endpoints, or anti-bot bypass.

sources.name: Avito Parts Красноярск
sources.api_status: public marketplace search is manual; an owner-approved Avito Business API integration may operate only AutoStop's own account via official authorization, not search other sellers' full catalog
sources.verification: Use only after checking photos, exact article, seller reliability, return terms, and whether the part is damaged or incomplete.

sources.name: МЕТРО / Автодом
sources.verification: Confirm exact article, physical stock, pickup address, package, and return terms by phone or written quote.

sources.name: КрасДеталь
sources.verification: Confirm the selected part number, current stock, price, and return terms in writing.

sources.name: Porshenkras
sources.verification: Confirm article, package, physical stock, price, and return terms.

sources.name: Автопоставка
sources.verification: Verify donor identity, exact part number, condition, completeness, warranty, and return terms.

integration_next_steps.task: Collect AutoStop supplier accounts and contacts for ROSSKO, ARMTEK, Autopiter, AutoEuro, Emex, Exist, Autodoc, and local Krasnoyarsk suppliers.
integration_next_steps.done_when: For each supplier, account status, city, price type, API/export availability, and manager contact are recorded outside Git in private settings.

integration_next_steps.task: Request API keys or price-list exports where allowed.
integration_next_steps.done_when: Credentials are stored in environment variables or a private secrets store, never in docs or repo.

integration_next_steps.task: Complete the shared read-only quote normalizer beyond the implemented Emex and Exist adapters.
integration_next_steps.done_when: One query returns comparable offers with source, stock, lead time, package, закупка, and confidence.

integration_next_steps.task: Add cache with timestamp and source quote id.
integration_next_steps.done_when: The agent can reuse fresh quotes but knows when price must be rechecked.

integration_next_steps.task: Keep supplier order mutations outside current read-only adapters; add them only inside an exact owner-authorized order workflow.
integration_next_steps.done_when: No adapter can place a paid supplier order without exact target preflight, idempotency, and result reconciliation.
